Fixes breaking change where `import moduleAlias from 'module-alias'`
would fail with "does not provide an export named 'default'".

The default export now provides the same API as CommonJS:
- moduleAlias(options) - init from package.json
- moduleAlias.addAlias()
- moduleAlias.addAliases()
- moduleAlias.addPath()
- moduleAlias.reset()
